en: Water expands by about nine percent in volume when it freezes into solid ice.
One liter of average ocean water contains about 35 grams of dissolved salt.
Osmium is the densest naturally occurring element, weighing twice as much as lead for the same volume.
Nitrogen makes up 78 percent of Earth's atmosphere, while oxygen accounts for 21 percent.
Solid gallium melts at exactly 29.76 degrees Celsius, meaning it turns into a liquid in your hand.
Over 99 percent of the visible universe is made of plasma, not solid, liquid, or gas.
Steel is an alloy mixture containing iron and less than two percent carbon by weight.
Diamond is the hardest natural mineral, ranking a perfect 10 on the Mohs hardness scale.
A single water molecule consists of exactly two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom.
Solid carbon dioxide, called dry ice, sublimates directly into gas at negative 78.5 degrees Celsius.
A single cubic centimeter of pure gold weighs exactly 19.3 grams at room temperature.
Pure water boils at exactly 100 degrees Celsius at standard sea-level atmospheric pressure.
